name: Sir Trashmuffin's Specter Network
body: He does not recognise property boundaries. The Raccoon Raceway extends from Ghost Haven through Wildwood Hearth into Specter Haven via a tunnel system the family insists they did not build but which appeared overnight after Trashmuffin spent three consecutive days glaring at the wall between the properties. His network threads both thigh wings, the pelvic floor and — improbably — the pool level, where a small waterproof hatch opens onto a heated nesting platform above the hot tub. He has stolen more panties from this house than from Ghost Haven. The girls blame the higher brat concentration. He accepts no accountability.
